### [`unused_room_lists_copy`](../../../src/unused_build_leftovers.asm#L7) `$572D-$58FF`

*data*

Unused. A byte-identical copy of lantern_list_ptr+16 .. room_frame_handlers ($4CF2-$4EC4): the pointers of rooms 8-19 of lantern_list_ptr, the lantern lists and room_init_handlers. No code reads it.

<a id="unused_source_text"></a>
### [`unused_source_text`](../../../src/unused_build_leftovers.asm#L71) `$5900-$59A4`

*data*

Unused. Assembler source text with bit 7 set on each character, left in memory by the build, for example " DFB $F0,$C0,$00,$00" and "* CHAR 97" (charset definitions). Lines end with $8D (CR). No code reads it; the coverage shows reads here only as the dummy reads of page-crossing LDA abs,X in setup_sprite_frame and expand_contact_mask.
